description: This file contains helper functions for ASN.1 encoding related to 3GPP NR (New Radio) specifications, including conversions for Q-hysteresis, Q-offset range, PCI range, and allowed measurement bandwidth, used in radio communication system configurations.

methods.name: asn1_utils::make_asn1_rrc_q_hyst
methods.description: Converts internal q_hyst_t enum to ASN.1 representation, with error handling for invalid values.

methods.name: asn1_utils::make_asn1_rrc_q_offset_range
methods.description: Converts internal q_offset_range_t enum to ASN.1 representation, with error handling for invalid values.

methods.name: asn1_utils::make_asn1_rrc_pci_range
methods.description: Creates ASN.1 PCI range structure from internal pci_range_t, mapping size to ASN.1 range options, with error handling for invalid sizes.

methods.name: asn1_utils::make_asn1_rrc_allowed_meas_bw
methods.description: Converts internal eutra_allowed_meas_bandwidth_t enum to ASN.1 representation, with error handling for invalid values.
